description: Canonical drain order for the kookr issue-batch selectors. Read by the selection step of parallel-issue-batch.md and implement-github-issue.md so a blank-shape scan proposes the safe no-gate tier before any gated (invariant-gate) issue, instead of picking arbitrarily.
rationale: The 2026-07-26 two-day retro (umbrella #1546) split the seeded backlog into a no-gate tier (docs/tests/small localized changes, safe to drain in any order) and a gated tier whose durable-state / concurrency semantics require the invariant-spec step defined in #1539. Until that gate workflow exists, the selector must drain the no-gate tier first and defer gated issues. Gated membership is expressed by the invariant-gate label on the issue (source of truth); this file additionally lists the seeded gated numbers so the simulation and audits can cross-check.
howToJoinATier: No-gate tier: append the issue number to noGateTier at the position you want it drained (order is significance-ranked, earliest first). Gated tier: add the invariant-gate label to the issue (gh issue edit <n> --add-label invariant-gate) and, for the seeded set, add its number to gatedTier. An issue carrying the invariant-gate label is always treated as gated even if it is not listed here, so future gated issues need only the label. A number must not appear in both tiers.
